summary: GitHub writes follow same-origin repository rename redirects without losing their method or body.

replay.detail: No replay. Existing watch declarations, cursors, deadlines and event deduplication remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Wire shapes are unchanged. Mutation requests now follow HTTP 301, 307 and 308 within the same API origin, preserving method and body. Redirects are admitted individually; cross-origin redirects remain rejected.
